   - Budget split across channels (%) with justification based on audience and campaign objective

   - Retargeting layers: site visitors / engagement audiences / CRM lists
   - Lookalike / similar audience expansion strategy

   - Creative angle for each audience segment: hook variant per audience

   - Target CPC, CPM, CPA, ROAS by channel
   - Optimization triggers: at what performance threshold to reallocate budget
